caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded stoneware jug with a narrow neck and a small handle attached to the upper portion near the mouth. The jug is predominantly a tan or light brown color, with some darker speckles and shading to show its form and texture. Toward the upper front of the jug, there are blue painted decorations consisting of a flower and a large, curved leaf or vine motif. Above the blue decoration, there is block text in black that reads “L. SEYMOUR / TROY FACTORY / 2.” The opening of the jug is circular and appears to have some wear or spots of a darker color. The composition of the drawing is centered, with the jug isolated against a plain, off-white or beige background. The artist’s signature is located in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
